defects: Uses bare `∏ n : {n : ℕ // 0 < n}, ...` big-operator notation, which desugars to `Finset.prod Finset.univ`, requiring a `Fintype` instance; `{n : ℕ // 0 < n}` is infinite and has no such instance, so this fails to elaborate as written.
Uses bare `∑ k : ℤ, ...` big-operator notation, which likewise requires `Fintype ℤ`; ℤ is infinite and has no `Fintype` instance, so this also fails to elaborate.
`(-1 : ℤ) ^ k` with `k : ℤ` needs an `HPow ℤ ℤ ℤ` (zpow) instance; ℤ is not a `DivisionRing`/`Group` under multiplication so no such instance exists, causing a further elaboration failure.

Even setting aside the type errors, the statement replaces the gold's topological convergence claim (`HasProd`, an infinite product converging to a limit in a topological ring) with a plain equality between finite-looking sum/product expressions, losing the analytic/topological content entirely.

Fixes the ring to R = ℤ instead of universally quantifying over an arbitrary topological commutative ring R as in the gold statement, dropping the generality (and the `TopologicalSpace`/`CommRing` hypotheses) of the original.
Does not use the canonical `pentagonalSeries R` definition from the gold statement; instead inlines a differently structured (and ill-typed) formula for the pentagonal series.
